# Perimeter Group Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


November 05, 2026 6:00 am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_aec30b412f53139cf2f1fe1180bb9694/perimetergroup/news/2026-11-05_Perimeter_Group_Reports_Third_Quarter_2026_91.pdf)

*Third* *quarter* *Net Income of $304.5M and Adjusted Net Income of $144.3M*


*Continued Value Driver execution and recent acquisitions drove third quarter Adjusted EBITDA of $223.5M*


*Third quarter Earnings Per Diluted Share of $1.74 and Adjusted Earnings Per Diluted Share of $0.85*


*Perimeter Group Inc. completed its name change from Perimeter Solutions, Inc.*


CHARLOTTE, N.C., Nov. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Perimeter Group Inc. (NYSE: PRM) (“Perimeter,” “Perimeter Group,” or the “Company”), a leading provider of industrial products and services that support critical and complex customer missions across a range of niche applications, today reported financial results for its third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**Third** **Quarter 2026 Results**


- Net sales increased 24% to $389.9 million in the third quarter, as compared to $315.4 million in the prior year quarter.


- Fire Safety net sales increased 14% to $312.6 million, as compared to $273.4 million in the prior year quarter.
- Specialty Products net sales increased 84% to $77.3 million, as compared to $42.0 million in the prior year quarter.


- Net income during the third quarter was $304.5 million, or $1.74 earnings per diluted share, as compared to a net loss of $90.7 million, or $0.62 loss per diluted share in the prior year quarter.
- Third quarter non-GAAP adjusted earnings per diluted share was $0.85, as compared to non-GAAP adjusted earnings per diluted share of $0.82 in the prior year quarter.
- Adjusted EBITDA increased 20% to $223.5 million in the third quarter, as compared to $186.3 million in the prior year quarter.


- Fire Safety Segment Adjusted EBITDA increased 14% to $201.6 million, as compared to $177.2 million in the prior year quarter.
- Specialty Products Segment Adjusted EBITDA increased 140% to $21.9 million, as compared to $9.1 million in the prior year quarter.


- Reconciliation tables for non-GAAP measures are available in the attached schedules.


**Year-to-Date 2026 Results**


- Net sales increased 32% to $728.7 million during the year-to-date period, as compared to $550.1 million in the prior year period.


- Fire Safety net sales increased 13% to $487.0 million, as compared to $430.8 million in the prior year period.
- Specialty Products net sales increased 103% to $241.7 million, as compared to $119.3 million in the prior year period.


- Net income during the year-to-date period was $195.8 million, or $1.14 earnings per diluted share, as compared to net loss of $66.1 million, or $0.45 loss per diluted share in the prior year period.
- Non-GAAP adjusted earnings per diluted share was $1.27, as compared to non-GAAP adjusted earnings per diluted share of $1.24 in the prior year period.
- Adjusted EBITDA increased 25% to $370.3 million in the year-to-date period, as compared to $295.7 million in the prior year period.


- Fire Safety Segment Adjusted EBITDA increased 13% to $299.1 million, as compared to $265.0 million in the prior year period.
- Specialty Products Segment Adjusted EBITDA increased 131% to $71.2 million, as compared to $30.7 million in the prior year period.


**Capital Allocation**


- On July 30, 2026, the Company completed the acquisition of Monaco Enterprises, Inc. (“Monaco”) for a total cash purchase price, net of cash acquired, of $117.1 million which was funded with cash on hand and proceeds from existing credit facilities.
- The Company invested $12.7 million in capital expenditures during the quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**Conference Call and Webcast**


As previously announced, Perimeter Group management will hold a conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET on Thursday, November 5, 2026 to discuss financial results for the third quarter 2026. The conference call can be accessed by dialing (800) 420-1459 (toll-free) or (203) 518-9861 (toll) and using Conference ID “PRMQ326”.


The conference call will also be webcast simultaneously on Perimeter’s website (https://ir.perimetergroup.com), accessed under the Investor Relations page. The webcast link will be made available on the Company's website prior to the start of the call; go to the investor relations page of our website to the News & Events menu and click on “Events & Presentations.”


A slide presentation will also be available for reference during the conference call; go to the investor relations page of our website to the News & Events menu and click on “Events & Presentations.”


Following the live webcast, a replay will be available on the Company’s website. The replay will be available until November 4, 2027 (11:59 p.m. ET).


**About Perimeter Group**


Perimeter Group (NYSE: PRM) is a leading provider of industrial products and services that support critical and complex customer missions across a range of niche applications. It comprises six market-leading businesses across two reporting segments: Fire Safety (Perimeter Solutions, Solberg Fire, and Monaco Enterprises) and Specialty Products (Phosphorus Derivatives Inc., Medical Manufacturing Technologies, and Intelligent Manufacturing Solutions). Perimeter prioritizes serving its customers’ needs while driving private-equity-like returns, all enabled by its Operational Value Drivers model and decentralized operating structure. Perimeter reinvests in its businesses to strengthen the products and services they provide to customers, and it expects to continue growing organically and through value-creating acquisitions.

**Non-GAAP Financial Metrics**


The Company provides non-GAAP financial measures for Adjusted EBITDA, Segment Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted Net Income, and Adjusted Earnings Per Share data as supplemental information regarding the Company’s business performance. The Company believes that these non-GAAP financial measures are useful to investors because they provide investors with a better understanding of the Company’s past financial performance and future results. The Company’s management uses these non-GAAP financial measures when it internally evaluates the performance of its business and makes operating decisions, including internal operating budgeting, performance measurement, and discretionary compensation.


*Adjusted EBITDA and Segment Adjusted EBITDA*


Adjusted EBITDA and Segment Adjusted EBITDA are defined as income (loss) before income taxes plus net interest and other financing expenses, and depreciation and amortization, adjusted on a consistent basis for certain non-recurring, unusual or non-operational items. These items include (i) restructuring, (ii) acquisition related costs, (iii) founder advisory fee expenses, (iv) stock-based compensation expense, (v) purchase accounting impact - inventory step up and (vi) foreign currency loss (gain). To supplement the Company’s condensed consolidated financial statements presented in accordance with U.S. GAAP, Perimeter is providing a summary to show the computations of Adjusted EBITDA and Segment Adjusted EBITDA, which are non-GAAP measures used by the Company's management and by external users of Perimeter’s financial statements, such as debt and equity investors, commercial banks and others, to assess the Company’s operating performance as compared to that of other companies, without regard to financing methods, capital structure or historical cost basis. Adjusted EBITDA and Segment Adjusted EBITDA should not be considered an alternative to net income (loss), operating income (loss), cash flows provided by (used in) operating activities or any other measure of financial performance or liquidity presented in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

*Adjusted Net Income and Adjusted Earnings Per Share*


The computation of Adjusted Earnings Per Share (“Adjusted EPS”) is defined as Adjusted Net Income divided by adjusted diluted shares. Adjusted Net Income is defined as net income (loss) plus amortization, certain non-recurring, unusual or non-operational items, and the tax impact of these non-GAAP adjustments. These adjustments include (i) restructuring, (ii) acquisition related costs, (iii) founder advisory fee expenses, (iv) stock-based compensation expense, (v) purchase accounting impact - inventory step up and (vi) foreign currency loss (gain). Adjusted diluted shares is the weighted average diluted shares outstanding, adjusted by adding dilution for options excluded under U.S. GAAP due to a net loss, less dilution related to founders advisory fees. To supplement the Company’s condensed consolidated financial statements presented in accordance with U.S. GAAP, Perimeter is providing a summary to show the computations of Adjusted Net Income and Adjusted EPS, which are non-GAAP measures used by the Company's management and by external users of Perimeter’s financial statements, such as debt and equity investors, commercial banks and others, to assess the Company's operating performance as compared to that of other companies, without regard to financing methods, capital structure or historical cost basis. Adjusted EPS and Adjusted Net Income should not be considered alternatives to GAAP earnings (loss) per share (“GAAP EPS”), net income (loss), operating income (loss), cash flows provided by (used in) operating activities or any other measure of financial performance or liquidity presented in accordance with U.S. GAAP.
